name: Battleship, British layout (our own model)
about: Made by tools/battle-models (ship). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 hull, 1 upper, 2 deck, 3 planks, 4 flight, 5 boot, 6 antifoul, 7 steel, 8 black, 9 canvas, 10 boat, 11 glass, 12 roof, 13 torn, 14 rope, 15 brass, 16 line, 17 red, 18 white, 19 lino, 20 cork, 21 bag, 22 door, 23 seam
